scenario.topic: Decide how to prioritize features in the next software release

options.name: Prioritize Features by Customer Demand
options.upside: Aligns development with user needs to improve satisfaction.
options.concern: May delay less popular but strategically important features.

options.name: Prioritize Features by Development Effort
options.upside: Enables faster delivery of features with lower complexity.
options.concern: Might overlook high-impact features requiring more effort.

options.name: Prioritize Features by Strategic Business Goals
options.upside: Supports alignment with company vision and market positioning.
options.concern: May reduce focus on immediate customer needs.

options.name: Prioritize Features by Technical Dependencies
options.upside: Ensures foundational improvements that enable future features.
options.concern: Could delay visible feature delivery to end users.

shared_context: The team must decide how to prioritize features for the next software release. Five participants will evaluate options based on impact, development effort, and customer demand to align with project goals and timelines.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a product strategist focused on aligning development with long-term company vision.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the software release supports sustainable growth and market positioning.

A.reason_for: Improves customer satisfaction by aligning with user needs.
A.reason_against: May delay strategic features important for long-term growth.

B.reason_for: Faster delivery can help maintain momentum.
B.reason_against: Focus on quick wins might neglect strategic priorities.

C.reason_for: Directly supports alignment with company vision and market positioning.

D.reason_for: Ensures system stability, which is important for future features.
D.reason_against: May delay visible features that customers want now.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a senior engineer who values efficient development and quick feature delivery.
personas.private_goal: Maximize throughput by focusing on low-effort, high-impact tasks.

A.reason_for: Customer feedback is valuable for prioritization.
A.reason_against: Effort can be variable, potentially slowing delivery.

B.reason_for: Enables faster delivery with lower complexity, maximizing throughput.

C.reason_for: Aligns with company goals but may slow down immediate progress.
C.reason_against: Variable time to market conflicts with quick wins focus.

D.reason_for: Improves system stability, which can reduce future rework.
D.reason_against: May delay delivering visible features to users.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a business analyst who emphasizes strategic alignment and measurable impact.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize features that drive long-term business growth and value.

A.reason_for: Customer satisfaction is important for sustained success.
A.reason_against: May detract from strategic initiatives needed for growth.

B.reason_against: Low effort focus risks ignoring impactful features.

C.reason_for: Supports company vision and long-term growth objectives.

D.reason_against: May postpone features that customers want now.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a customer success manager passionate about delivering value directly to users.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the release maximizes customer satisfaction and engagement.

A.reason_for: Aligns development with user needs, improving satisfaction.

B.reason_for: Faster delivery is good but may overlook customer priorities.
B.reason_against: Might miss features that customers truly want.

C.reason_for: Supports company vision and long-term goals.
C.reason_against: Less focus on immediate customer needs.

D.reason_for: Technical stability is important for user experience.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a systems architect focused on maintaining a stable and scalable platform.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize foundational improvements to enable future innovation.

A.reason_for: Customer satisfaction is important but not primary here.
A.reason_against: May delay critical technical work needed for stability.

B.reason_for: Quick wins help maintain progress while improving system.

C.reason_for: Supports strategic goals but may not address immediate technical needs.
C.reason_against: Variable effort and time to market complicate planning.

D.reason_for: Ensures foundational improvements that enable future features.

acceptance_reasons.D: Improves system stability, which can reduce future rework.

acceptance_reasons.C: Supports company vision and long-term goals.
